title: The Witcher 3 breaks its all-time Steam record 🐺
subject: witcher3
description:
Are you jumping back into The Witcher 3? 👇

The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt hit 137,724 concurrent players on Steam, beating its January 2020 record of 103,329. The boost comes from The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered, a free upgrade for owners released September 29, 2026 that bundles both expansions.

Sources: SteamDB, GamesRadar+ (Oct 5, 2026), CD PROJEKT RED
Game footage © CD PROJEKT RED.

scenes.text: The Witcher 3 just broke its all-time Steam record.
This past weekend, it hit 137,724 players at the same time, according to SteamDB.
The old record was 103,329, set in January 2020, right after the Netflix series.

scenes.text: The reason? The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered, released September 29 as a free upgrade for owners.
